title: An exact average Goldbach representation formula, after Goldston and Suriajaya
summary: A sorry-free Lean 4 proof, with no hypothesis, of Theorem 1, equation 11, of D. A. Goldston and A. I. Suriajaya, On an average Goldbach representation formula of Fujii, Nagoya Math. J. 250, 2023, 511 to 532, arXiv 2110.14250v2. With psi_2(n) the sum over m + m' = n of Lambda(m) Lambda(m'), for every integer N >= 2 the sum over n = 1 of N^{1-2k} divided by k times 2k-1, plus E(N), an exact identity with E(N) the integral of equation 12.
